# Gene Ontology and Enrichment - Haplotypes

## Load packages and Haplotype significance data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(VariantAnnotation)
library(biomaRt)

library(org.Dm.eg.db)
library(TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene)

library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)

HapO_adjpvals <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/hap_pvals_adj.RDS")
# prefix CHROM names with "chr" to match the genes database chromosome names.
HapO_adjpvals <- HapO_adjpvals %>% mutate(CHROM = paste0("chr", CHROM))
# filter out significant SNPs
sig_SNPs <- HapO_adjpvals %>% filter(adj_p < 0.05)

```

## Retrieve annotated genes and map target SNPs

```{r}

# load Drosophila melanogaster genomic architechture
txdb <- TxDb.Dmelanogaster.UCSC.dm6.ensGene
# load all D. melanogaster genes coordinates data
genes_data <- genes(txdb)

# Map all SNP data to genes based on coordinates
SNP_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = HapO_adjpvals$CHROM,
    ranges = IRanges(start = HapO_adjpvals$POS, end = HapO_adjpvals$POS),
    strand = "*"
  )
  
SNP_overlaps <- subsetByOverlaps(genes_data, SNP_gr)
SNP_gene_IDs <- unique(as.data.frame(SNP_overlaps)$gene_id)


# Map significant SNP data to genes based on coordinates
# This code maps which genic coordinates a given SNP falls upon
sig_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = sig_SNPs$CHROM,
    ranges = IRanges(start = sig_SNPs$POS, end = sig_SNPs$POS),
    strand = "*"
  )
  
sig_overlaps <- subsetByOverlaps(genes_data, sig_gr)
sig_gene_IDs <- unique(as.data.frame(sig_overlaps)$gene_id)
sig_gene_df <- as.data.frame(sig_overlaps)

sig_gene_df$symbol <- mapIds(org.Dm.eg.db, 
                      keys = sig_gene_df$gene_id,
                      column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL")

# This code takes the gene ranges data above (with SNPs mapped to genic coordinates),
# and expands upon that by specifying which structure of the gene (exon, intron, etc.) 
# the given SNP is present at.
loc_annotations <- locateVariants(query = sig_gr,
                                  subject = txdb,
                                  region = AllVariants())

loc_annot_df <- as.data.frame(loc_annotations)

# gene structural IDs are stored as nested lists, since a single SNP could belong to multiple genes' structures. list_cols specifies which columns exist as lists.
list_cols <- sapply(loc_annot_df, is.list)
# The columns existing as lists are flattened into a single entry separated by ";"
loc_annot_df[list_cols] <- lapply(loc_annot_df[list_cols], function(col) {
  sapply(col, paste, collapse = ";")
})

```

### Gene Enrichment

```{r}
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "dmelanogaster_gene_ensembl")

mapped_gene_IDs <- unique(c(sig_gene_IDs, SNP_gene_IDs))

GO_annotations <- biomaRt::getBM(
attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "description", "go_id", "name_1006", "go_linkage_type", "external_gene_name"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = mapped_gene_IDs,
  mart = ensembl
)

unwanted_GO <- c("TAS", "NAS", "IC", "ND")
reliable_GO <- GO_annotations[!GO_annotations$go_linkage_type %in% 
                                unwanted_GO, ]

universe_genes <- unique(reliable_GO$ensembl_gene_id)
# These IDs are filtered versions (quality controlled through annotation and removal of unwanted terms) of sig_gene_IDs and SNP_gene_IDs
sig_annot_IDs <- universe_genes[universe_genes %in% sig_gene_IDs]
universe_IDs <- universe_genes[universe_genes %in% SNP_gene_IDs]


aggregate_GO <- reliable_GO %>% 
  filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% sig_gene_IDs) %>% 
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    GO_IDs = paste(unique(go_id), collapse = "; "),
    GO_names = paste(unique(name_1006), collapse = "; "),
    Descriptions = paste(unique(description), collapse = "; "),
    Ext_gene_names = paste(unique(external_gene_name), collapse = "; ")
  )

genes_result <- left_join(sig_gene_df, aggregate_GO, 
                          by = c("gene_id" = "ensembl_gene_id"))

GO_results <- enrichGO(
  gene = sig_annot_IDs,
  
  OrgDb = org.Dm.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENSEMBL",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

GO_results_df <- as.data.frame(GO_results)

GO_simple <- simplify(GO_results)

final_GO <- as.data.frame(GO_simple)

Hap_enrich_plt <- dotplot(GO_simple, showCategory = 21)

print(Hap_enrich_plt)
```

#### Extract definitions of Biological Process GO terms

```{r}
Hap_enrich_defs <- as_tibble(GO_simple)

Hap_enrich_defs$Definitions <- sapply(Hap_enrich_defs$ID, function(id) {
  def <- Definition(GO.db::GOTERM[id])
  if (is.null(def)) return(NA) else return(def)
})

Hap_enrich_defs <- Hap_enrich_defs %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, Definitions)
```

### Combination of SNP data with enriched biological pathways

This code aims to combine a manhattan plot of significance with gene enrichment data.

#### Get SNP positions for enriched pathways

```{r}
# load final enrichment results, made separate rows for genes
pathway_map <- final_GO %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, geneID) %>% 
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>% 
  rename(ensembl_gene_id = geneID, pathway_name = Description)

# find overlaps between the significant sites and the genes database
snp_genes <- findOverlaps(sig_gr, genes_data)

# prepare a dataframe for joining
snp_genes_df <- data.frame(
  # snp id gets the snp number associated with a mapped gene.
  # e.g. if it's the first SNP, snp_id will be '1'
  snp_id = queryHits(snp_genes),
  # get the ENSEMBL database gene id for mapped significant genes
  ensembl_gene_id = genes_data$gene_id[subjectHits(snp_genes)])

# combine 3 dataframes to get a dataset with SNP id and genes, pathways names
snp_pathways_map <- sig_SNPs %>% 
  # gives each signficant SNP its serial number, 1 onwards
  mutate(snp_id = row_number()) %>%
  # joins the mapped dataframe serial numbers with significant SNP
  left_join(snp_genes_df, by = 'snp_id') %>% 
  # joins the enriched pathways to the significant SNPs and their mapped genes
  left_join(pathway_map, 
      by = 'ensembl_gene_id', relationship = 'many-to-many') %>% 
  mutate(symbol = mapIds(org.Dm.eg.db, keys = ensembl_gene_id,
                         column = 'SYMBOL', keytype = 'ENSEMBL'))


# remove 'chr' from CHROM names
Full_SNP <- HapO_adjpvals %>% 
  mutate(CHROM = gsub("^chr", "", CHROM))

# cumulative positions per chromosome. used to plot continuous X
chr_length <- Full_SNP %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% 
  summarise(max_pos = max(POS), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  mutate(pos_add = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(max_pos)), 
                       default = 0)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(CHROM, pos_add)

# convert SNP positions to cumulative positions across chrom
Full_SNP <- Full_SNP %>% inner_join(chr_length, by = 'CHROM') %>% 
  mutate(pos_cumul = POS + pos_add)
 
# convert SNP positions to cumulative positions across chrom
snp_pathways_map <- snp_pathways_map %>% 
  mutate(CHROM = gsub("^chr", "", CHROM)) %>% 
  inner_join(chr_length, by = 'CHROM') %>% 
  mutate(pos_cumul = POS + pos_add)

# filter out any SNPs that do not map to pathways
snp_pathways <- snp_pathways_map %>% 
                    filter(!is.na(pathway_name))

# identify most significant SNP for each enriched pathway
peak_snp_labels <- snp_pathways %>% 
  group_by(pathway_name, symbol) %>%
  # slices each pathway and symbol combination to only select the row (SNP) which has the lowest adjusted p-value
  slice_min(order_by = .data[["adj_p"]], 
  # single value, in case of ties (draws) in max value, 
  # first n value is considered
            n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  # highlights only the distinct positions for each label
  distinct(pos_cumul, symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  # filters out the hundreds of possible labels by showing the top differentiated positions of haplotype differentiation
  filter(adj_p < 0.001)

# chromosome tick positions
chrom_ticks <- Full_SNP %>% group_by(CHROM) %>% 
  summarise(center_pos = (max(pos_cumul) + min(pos_cumul))/2,
            .groups = 'drop')
```

#### Make the combined Manhattan plot

```{r}
Hap_sig_path_plot <- ggplot() +
  # All SNP data, in grey background
  geom_point(data = Full_SNP,
             aes(x = pos_cumul, y = -log10(adj_p)), 
             color = 'grey80', alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
  # significant SNPs color-coded by pathway names
  geom_point(data = snp_pathways, 
  aes(x = pos_cumul, y = -log10(adj_p),
      color = pathway_name), size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  # labels of gene symbols associated with the GO terms
  geom_label_repel(data = peak_snp_labels,
  aes(x = pos_cumul, y = -log10(adj_p), 
      label = symbol, color = pathway_name), 
  box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 20,
  size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Paired') +
  scale_x_continuous(label = chrom_ticks$CHROM, 
                     breaks = chrom_ticks$center_pos) +
  labs(title = "Enriched Biological Processes and associated genes\nmapped to different haplotype compositions (CONvs.FP)",
       x = "Chromosome", y = "-log10(adjusted P-value)",
       color = "Enriched Biological Process") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face = 'bold'))

print(Hap_sig_path_plot)
```

```{r}
# get gene length
exons <- exonsBy(txdb, by = "gene")
gene_lengths <- sum(width(reduce(exons)))

gene_lengths_df <- tibble(gene_ID = names(gene_lengths),
                          gene_length = as.numeric(gene_lengths))

# already present data sig_genes_df contains FBgn values and symbols, selecting those columns and joining with exon length
geneid_symbol <- sig_gene_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_id, symbol) %>% rename(gene_ID = gene_id)

sig_gene_lengths <- geneid_symbol %>% 
  left_join(gene_lengths_df, by = "gene_ID")

heat_plot_dataraw <- snp_pathways %>% #filter(adj_p < 0.001) %>%
  # symbol is a list, this makes symbol a factor
  mutate(symbol = sapply(symbol, 
function(x) ifelse(length(x)>0, x[1], NA_character_))) %>% 
  group_by(symbol, pathway_name) %>% 
  summarise(sig_sites = as.numeric(n_distinct(pos_cumul)), 
            .groups = 'drop') 

heat_plot_data <- heat_plot_dataraw %>% 
  left_join(sig_gene_lengths, by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(symbol = factor(symbol), 
         pathway_name = factor(pathway_name),
         # calculate density of significant site in gene 
         # the denominator is exon length for the gene
         sig_density = sig_sites/gene_length) %>% 
  group_by(symbol) %>% 
  mutate(overlap_count = as.numeric(n_distinct(pathway_name))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # rank the genes by density of significant sites in genes
    density_rank = dense_rank(dplyr::desc(sig_density)),
    # rank the genes by number of significant sites
    sites_rank = dense_rank(dplyr::desc(sig_sites)))

# Plot of rank of gene based on number of sites vs. density of significant sites
heat_plot_data %>% distinct(symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = density_rank, y = sites_rank, 
             color = log10(gene_length))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1) +
  labs(x = "Number of significant sites", 
       y = "Density of significant sites") +
  theme_cowplot()

# count how many genes are present at each overlap count
genes_pathways <- heat_plot_data %>% 
  distinct(symbol, overlap_count) %>% 
  dplyr::count(overlap_count, name = "genes_contrib")

heat_plot_GO_sig <- heat_plot_data %>% 
  filter(sites_rank <= 10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = symbol, y = pathway_name, fill = sig_density)) +
  geom_tile(color = 'white', linewidth = 0.5) +
  #geom_text(aes(label = sig_sites), 
   #         color = 'black', fontface = 'bold', size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma', direction = -1) +
  labs(y = "Biological Process", x = "Gene Symbol", 
    fill = "Density of significant sites in gene \n(no. significant sites/exon length)",
    title = "Genes contributing to Enriched Biological Processes\n
       Top 10 genes by number of significant genomic sites") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust=1, hjust=1))

print(heat_plot_GO_sig)

heat_plot_GO_dens <- heat_plot_data %>% 
  filter(density_rank <= 10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = symbol, y = pathway_name, fill = sig_sites)) +
  geom_tile(color = 'white', linewidth = 0.5) +
  #geom_text(aes(label = sig_sites), 
   #         color = 'black', fontface = 'bold', size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma', direction = -1) +
  labs(y = "Biological Process", x = "Gene Symbol", 
    fill = "Number of significant sites in gene",
    title = "Genes contributing to Enriched Biological Processes\n
       Top 10 genes by density of significant genomic sites\n
    (No. of significant sites/exon length)") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust=1, hjust=1))

print(heat_plot_GO_dens)
```

## Comparisons of genes with other studies

Load data from haplotype gene enrichment analysis

```{r}
hap_enrich <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/hap_GO_enrich.RDS")

hap_enrich <- hap_enrich %>% 
# symbol is a list, this makes symbol a factor
  mutate(symbol = sapply(symbol, 
function(x) ifelse(length(x)>0, x[1], NA_character_))) %>% 
  distinct(symbol, pathway_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

hap_genes <- unique(hap_enrich$ensembl_gene_id)

hap_genesymbols <- unique(hap_enrich$symbol)

hap_pathways <- unique(hap_enrich$pathway_name)


# load SNP enrich data
SNP_enrich <- readRDS(
  "../../../Big_data/SNP_pathways_symbols.RDS")

SNP_enrich <- SNP_enrich %>% 
  # symbol is a list, this makes symbol a factor
  mutate(symbol = sapply(symbol, 
function(x) ifelse(length(x)>0, x[1], NA_character_))) %>% 
  distinct(symbol, pathway_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

SNP_pathways <- unique(SNP_enrich$pathway_name)
SNP_genesymbols <- unique(SNP_enrich$symbol)
SNP_genes <- unique(SNP_enrich$ensembl_gene_id)


```

### Spierer et al. 2021 (PloS Genetics) Flight performance genes (DGRP)

Flight performance was calculated as a self-righting ability after flies were released down a vertical tube

```{r}
spierer_data_raw <- read_excel("../../../Raw_data/Spierer_etal_2021_plosgen_genes.xlsx")


spierer_genesymbols <- spierer_data_raw %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Gene Symbols`) %>% dplyr::slice(-1)
spierer_genesymbols <- unique(spierer_genesymbols$`Gene Symbols`)

spierer_genes <- spierer_data_raw %>% dplyr::select(...11) %>% 
  dplyr::slice(-1)
spierer_genes <- unique(spierer_genes$...11)
```

### Pitcher et al. 2019 (Genetics) Wing shape genes (DGRP)

```{r}
pitcher_data_raw <- read_excel("../../../Raw_data/Pitcher_etal_2019_wingshape_genes.xlsx", skip = 2)

pitcher_pathways <- pitcher_data_raw$description

pitcher_genes_raw <- pitcher_data_raw %>% 
  dplyr::select(OverlapGene)

pitcher_genes <- pitcher_genes_raw %>% mutate(
gene_names = str_extract_all(
  OverlapGene, "(?<=FLYBASE:)[^;]+")) %>%
  unnest(gene_names) %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_names) # %>% distinct(gene_names)

pitcher_genes <- unique(pitcher_genes$gene_names)
```

#### Find overlaps between genes

SNP analysis overlaps

```{r}
# testing overlaps between haplotype analysis and SNP differentiation for genes, pathways
hap_SNP_genes_ol <- intersect(hap_genes, SNP_genes)
hap_SNP_genesymbols_ol <- intersect(hap_genesymbols, SNP_genesymbols)
hap_SNP_pathways_ol <- intersect(hap_pathways, SNP_pathways)

# testing overlaps between SNP differentiation analysis and Spierer et al. 2021 data for genes, pathways
SNP_spierer_genes_ol <- intersect(SNP_genes, spierer_genes)
SNP_spierer_symbols_ol <- intersect(
  SNP_genesymbols, spierer_genesymbols)

# testing overlaps between SNP differentiation analysis and Pitcher et al. 2019 data for genes, pathways
SNP_pitcher_path_ol <- intersect(SNP_pathways, pitcher_pathways)
SNP_pitcher_genes_ol <- intersect(SNP_genes, pitcher_genes)
```

Haplotype analysis overlaps

```{r}
# testing overlaps between haplotype analysis and Spierer et al. 2021 data for genes, pathways
hap_spierer_genes_ol <- intersect(hap_genes, spierer_genes)
hap_spierer_symbols_ol <- intersect(
  hap_genesymbols, spierer_genesymbols)
hap_spierer_overlaps <- tibble(
  overlap_genes = hap_spierer_genes_ol) %>% 
  left_join(hap_enrich,  
            by = c("overlap_genes" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
  distinct(overlap_genes, .keep_all = TRUE)


# testing overlaps between haplotype analysis and Pitcher et al. 2019 data for genes, pathways
hap_pitcher_path_ol <- intersect(hap_pathways, pitcher_pathways)
hap_pitcher_genes_ol <- intersect(hap_genes, pitcher_genes)
hap_pitcher_overlaps <- tibble(
  overlap_genes = hap_pitcher_genes_ol) %>% 
  left_join(hap_enrich,  
            by = c("overlap_genes" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
  distinct(overlap_genes, .keep_all = TRUE)
```
